note: Adapted from Snyder's 1926 original description (in English), placed in the subgenus Nasutitermes (Nasutitermes); includes the soldier and worker, the type specimen collected by W. M. Mann in Brazil together with soldiers and workers of Microcerotermes arboreus in a tree nest; no alate is described in the original.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head broadly rounded, the vertex flat, head length including the nasus 1.80 mm, head width 1.30 mm, nasus slightly paler, slender and with the tip bent down; the worker belongs to the large species group, total length 5.00—5.75 mm, head width 1.65—1.75 mm. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 elongate and subclavate, longer than segments 2 and 4, segment 5 again longer than segment 4.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head chestnut-brown with a reddish tone, smooth and glossy, with 1 row of bristles at the base of the nasus, on the vertex and on the posterior margin (the posterior row sometimes absent); lateral outline nearly straight except for the elevation at the base of the nasus; head broadly rounded, the vertex flat. Nasus slightly paler, slender and not very thick, the tip bent down. Mandibles pointed. Antennae yellowish brown, 13-segmented, the middle segments elongate and shortening towards the tip, with long hairs; segment 3 elongate and subclavate, longer than segments 2 and 4; segment 4 longer than segment 2; segment 5 longer than segment 4; terminal segment slender, short, suboval. Pronotum yellowish brown, darker anteriorly, saddle-shaped, anterior margin not concave, with long hairs. Legs pale yellowish brown, slender, with long hairs. Abdominal tergites chestnut-brown with a reddish tone, each with a row of long bristles at its base; cerci rather long. Measurements: total length 4.00—4.20 mm; head including nasus 1.80 mm; head length (without nasus, to the anterior margin) 1.25 mm; nasus length 0.65 mm; pronotum length 0.30 mm; hind tibia length 1.45 mm; head width 1.30 mm; pronotum width 0.80 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head chestnut-brown with a greyish tone, with translucent markings, a median longitudinal line from the fontanelle to the cranial suture. Antennae 14-segmented. Measurements: worker total length 5.00—5.75 mm; head length 1.95—2.00 mm; head width 1.65—1.75 mm.
